book.name: Galatia
book.title: Galatia Galatia Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa

content: E ꞌahi reihi. Moga tohe niduꞌa meiteꞌe ubugaꞌe ḡau niduꞌa meiroteꞌe vazeḡa rehano, komeꞌa madaḡanoꞌe aniꞌe tuḡure vazeḡa heuḡa.
Ani komeꞌa madaḡano, aniꞌe ane taufeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu ane ḡau taufeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ḡoere egoziniꞌohe, onamo moganiꞌa ohoniroteꞌe madaḡa meꞌuma.
Eꞌe teige, emeꞌe komeꞌa madaḡano raha ꞌadi ibitohauꞌeteꞌe viga
nunu hegotadu tuḡure azaḡa teige radiunu.
Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa ohoniroteꞌe madaḡa meirotene, Badiꞌaꞌa Ubuga tuḡunadu aniꞌe roḡae ꞌahoga mazaonoꞌo fureraro ebu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌenaꞌa radiro.
Badiꞌaꞌa Ubuga tuḡunirotaꞌaꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌanonoꞌo vaze bohaze buzoga veize, zu emeꞌe Badiꞌa ubuga rae rouga veize reiro.
Zaꞌe Badiꞌa ubuga uꞌano, aniꞌa Ubuga Viga emeḡe zamao tuḡuniro, eꞌanoꞌo Ubuga Viga uꞌano emeꞌa Badiꞌa mazao, “Mama,
eḡe Mama,” rae huneꞌohe.
Eꞌanoꞌo zae tibatibaꞌe tuḡure azaḡano mene bare raꞌohe, rehano Badiꞌa ubuga rae raꞌohe. Zaꞌe Badiꞌa ubugaubuga uꞌano, Badiꞌaꞌa ane ubugaubuga ziniteꞌe toheḡa niduꞌa zae zuni ziniꞌuma.
Pauloꞌa Galatia Ekalesia Azaḡa Zamare Borofiro
Ibite zaꞌe Badiꞌa aḡuꞌa madaḡano mene badiꞌa huga rae raꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa hegotadu ane tuḡure azaḡano reiro.

Rehano izidi zaꞌe Badiꞌa edeḡa. Hube hune, e Badiꞌaꞌa za ederiro rae reꞌuma. Rehano za nougadu raha ꞌada ibitohauꞌeteꞌe viga nunu bare vaḡeꞌohe? Aꞌe inaraḡa oꞌoꞌa zu huga oꞌoꞌa. Zaꞌe deꞌeguḡa viga hegoteꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡano bare reihi raꞌehe?
Zaeꞌa Iuda azaḡa haḡai teige, mada boro nunu, bato boro nunu, irugu zu nahune madaḡa nunu ebu muri nunu hegoteꞌohe.
ꞌOugadu, “E zae veize gauinutaꞌaꞌe foure reꞌuma ga?” rae zamaheꞌa aduduꞌohe.
Nego nabudi, e umizeꞌohe. Eꞌe Iuda azaḡa goro ḡoeꞌa modadu zae teigiro, eꞌanoꞌo zae zuni eḡe teige Iuda azaḡa goro ḡoeꞌa ago hegotoꞌi. Zaꞌa eḡe mazao veꞌoḡa mene haḡairo.
Za edeḡa, e ugihadu zae vaḡe amiro ebu hari manoḡa zae mazao ḡadahe haramiro.
Za ugihe horonadu zamazeꞌa adudaro gaogi rehano, e mene ovoe ḡiahiro zu mene hezahohiro. Ebu Badiꞌa tuḡure viga ga Iesu Keriso teige mae ḡihihiro.
Eꞌe madaḡano zaeꞌa ufeta matuꞌe rudanadu zaꞌe idaḡa reifone ubumaze ḡude vaḡinadu eḡe inihi rae reifo.
Eꞌe moneo eꞌa vaze mazao rae furenoga zuni idaḡa. Rehano izidi zae matuꞌu aꞌe nougeha?
Eḡeꞌa ḡoere huga zeadu eꞌe zae agire vazeḡa reirohe?
Ḡuriro ihore azaḡaꞌe zaeꞌa manoḡa mouga veize za mene zamareꞌohe. Zeꞌe eme mazaonoꞌo zae mae vaḡizadu zaeꞌa ze inare hegotoga daꞌo urateꞌohe.
Iniuꞌa zae danazifine inarine, aꞌe manoḡa. Mene eḡeꞌa zae teite radiuꞌeteꞌe madaḡano daꞌo, rehano mada niduꞌa ꞌougine, manoḡa.
Eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa, roḡaeꞌa ene fureneꞌeteꞌe madaḡano gigiꞌa maꞌeteꞌe teige, e zae uꞌano bare gigiꞌa maꞌohe, onamo zaeꞌa Keriso teigiꞌuma.
E izidi zae teite radadu negane roḡeru ḡorezihi raꞌohe, mazaḡa e zae moneo ꞌadaꞌadaheꞌohe.
Hagara zu Sara Hari Idaidaḡa
Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegote radihi raꞌeteꞌe azaḡa, ehoꞌi! Za Mose goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa nagini raꞌetaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌahe?
Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro. Aberahamoꞌe ubuga aheu. ꞌAhogaꞌe tuḡure roḡaeḡaniꞌa fureniro, u ꞌahogaꞌe mene tuḡure roḡaeḡaniꞌa fureniro.
Tuḡure roḡaeḡa mazaonoꞌo fureraroteꞌe ubugaꞌe vaze ahiri ibiḡano fureraro, u mene tuḡure roḡaeḡa mazaonoꞌo fureraroteꞌe ubugaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa ḡoitoriroteꞌe ḡoeꞌanonoꞌo fureraro.

Aꞌe hari idaidaḡa raꞌohe. Roḡae aheu aꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa vaze teite ḡoitoriroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa aheu. Roḡae tibaꞌe Hagara. Hagaraꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa Sinai maḡano ziniroteꞌe goroḡa ḡoeꞌa heuḡa. Eꞌe goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa vaze tutuzadu Hagara ubugaubuga teige, eꞌe goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡano mae tiro.
Hagaraꞌe Arabia habaꞌano Sinai maḡa teite idaniro, ebu izidiꞌe Ierusalema ne boro teite idaniro. Ierusalemaꞌe Ierusalema azaḡa teite goro ḡoeꞌa eꞌe hegoteꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡa teige radiuꞌohe.
Rehano adure Ierusalemaḡaꞌe mene tuḡure roḡaeḡa ebu aꞌe emeḡe nanu.
Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro,

content.text: Mazaḡa iniu ane daꞌo radiuꞌeteꞌe roḡaeḡa ubugaubugaꞌe ḡeharaꞌuma.
Zeꞌe iꞌa teite radiuꞌeteꞌe roḡaeḡa ubugaubuga ufeta vitize ḡeharaꞌuma.”

content: Nego nabudi, zaꞌe Isako teige Badiꞌaꞌa ḡoitoriroteꞌe ubugaubuga.
Rehano Aberahamo madaḡano vaze ahiri ibiḡano fureraroteꞌe ubuganiꞌa Vine Zaḡoḡa gigiꞌaonoꞌo fureraroteꞌe ubuga aduga boro haro. Eꞌe teige, izidi zuni ꞌuguḡaniꞌa fureruꞌohe.
Rehano Buka Zaḡoḡano nouge rae raꞌohe? “Tuḡure roḡaeḡa ubugeta hegozoꞌi, mazaḡa tuḡure roḡaeḡa ubugaꞌe mene tuḡure roḡaeḡa ubuga teite moga tohe mene hune hidiꞌuma.”
Eꞌanoꞌo, nego nabudi, emeꞌe mene tuḡure roḡaeḡa ubugaubuga, rehano tuḡure mene haḡaeꞌeteꞌe roḡaeḡa ubugaubuga.

footnotes.text: Paulo ubuma ugiḡeta radu ze ani vetuḡaniro.
